subject: Request: Amendment for additional capacity & rate update
messages:
From: Amit Reddy <amit.reddy@solislabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Megan O'Neill <m.oneill@solislabs.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Amendment for additional capacity & rate update

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our side — our Q3 usage forecast just jumped due to a large customer pilot; we need to add ~250 vGPU-hours / day and would like to discuss a corresponding amendment to our Order Form (Exhibit A + fee schedule). We ran the numbers and this would also change the unit price tiers (we've sketched a target rate that keeps the overall spend within our budget but shifts the midpoint on tiers).

Attached is a rough projection (capacity_projections_Q3.xlsx) and a plaintext redline of the Order Form (solis_amendment_redline_v1.docx). High level asks:
- Add the 250 vGPU-hours/day supplement to Exhibit A as a temporary tranche (Q3 only)
- Apply revised per-token/per-embedding rates for that tranche and define a clear sunset/rollback date
- Confirm that current SLA/latency commitments carry over; if not, call out any changes

Can you confirm next steps and expected timing for legal redline and signatures? We are aiming to have this live by Aug 10 to support the pilot.

Thanks,
Amit
Amit Reddy
Head of Platform Partnerships, Solis Labs

Hi Amit — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the projection. This is the right level of detail to start.

Next steps from our side:
1) I'll run this past Commercial (Karthik) to validate the target rates and confirm billing mechanics.
2) I'll ask Legal (Laura) to review the redline and confirm whether we can treat this as a temporary tranche with automatic rollback on Sep 30.
3) If Legal signs off, we will prepare a short amendment (Order Form Addendum) that edits Exhibit A and the fee schedule only — minimal MSA changes.

Target timeline: legal review by EOD Tue (Jul 31), internal sign-off Wed morning, prep DocuSign package Wed afternoon so you can route for signature. I *think* we can hit Aug 10 but need Legal to confirm SLA preservation.

Laura / Karthik — looping you in. Key items to look for: the amendment should
- explicitly define the tranche start/end dates and billing treatment,
- include a clause stating SLA (latency/uptime) remains unchanged for production traffic routed to the existing deployment,
- and an opt-out if Solis elects to revert to baseline earlier.

Amit — if you can confirm the capacity tranche dates you want (start date, Aug 1?) and signatory for the DocuSign envelope that will help speed things up.

Best,

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Amendment for additional capacity & rate update

Marissa / team — reviewed Amit's redline and the projection. High-level legal view below.

1) Scope / drafting approach- We can keep this as a short Order Form Addendum that amends Exhibit A and the fee schedule only. No MSA amendment required, provided there are no changes to data residency/processing terms.
- Proposed language (suggested clause to add to Order Form Addendum):
  "Temporary Capacity Tranche: For the period beginning 2028-08-01 and ending 2028-09-30 (the 'Tranche Period'), Customer shall receive an incremental allocation of 250 vGPU-hours/day. Charges for usage occurring within the Tranche Period shall be billed at the tranche unit rates specified in Exhibit A (Tranche Pricing). Upon the expiration of the Tranche Period, allocations and rates shall revert to those set forth in the baseline Order Form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the parties."

2) SLA / performance warranties- We should not commit additional SLA credits tied to the tranche unless Ops confirms dedicated capacity. Recommend the amendment include: "Customer's SLA entitlements under the MSA remain unchanged; additional capacity provided under the Tranche is best-effort and not a basis for increased SLA credits unless otherwise specified in a separate written addendum." That preserves our exposure.

3) Billing mechanics / taxes- We need to confirm whether the tranche billing will be invoiced as a separate line item (preferred) or blended into the monthly invoice. Commercial preference? Karthik pls advise.

4) Acceptance / rollback- Include a simple opt-out: Customer may notify Redwood in writing by 2028-08-10 to cancel the tranche before it goes live. If canceled after the Tranche Period begins, charges for usage through cancellation are still owed.

I've attached a short redline with inline comments (redline_notes_legal.txt). If Marissa/Karthik confirm commercial approach we can push a tracked-change addendum to Amit for signature.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: redline_notes_legal.txt (notes, .txt stub)
